title: 暂停前构建记录和产物保留

#!/bin/sh
# E2E fake gradlew: deterministic success, no Android SDK needed.
echo '> Task :app:preBuild UP-TO-DATE'
echo '> Task :app:assembleDebug'
mkdir -p app/build/outputs/apk/debug
printf 'PK\x03\x04E2E-FAKE-APK' > app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
echo 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 2s'
exit 0
